name: Yume Assistant
description: Answers questions in Spanish or English about Yume's personalized stationery products (medical prescription pads, custom stickers), pricing, and coverage area from Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico, with nationwide shipping, points to relevant blog guides, and helps request a quote via WhatsApp.

skills.name: Answer questions
skills.description: Answer questions about products, pricing, coverage area, and point to relevant blog guides (e.g. pet stickers, prescription requirements, vinyl vs. paper), in Spanish or English.
examples: How much are the custom logo stickers?
What should a medical prescription include?

skills.name: Request a quote
skills.description: Point the user to Yume's WhatsApp to start a real quote.
examples: How do I place an order?
